title: Tsukazu Hanarezu
description:
Reunited with the girl I liked back in school! After listening to her vent, things started to heat up! Could this be my big chance, 10 years in the making!?
A 20-page love story brought to life by a skilled artist!!

Originally published in Weekly Young Magazine on Jan 6 2023
